basic_info.description: Handsome top-floor Edw condo has spectacular views over the Outerlands, from the Marin Headlands & Ocean Beach to Golden Gate Park.  Voluminous, sunny floor plan. Exceptional character & detail; hardwood floors throughout. Living room has graceful room-width windows, built-ins, fireplace & views of Golden Gate Bridge & the Richmond district. Adjacent oversized formal dining room. Newly remodeled, custom-designed kitchen. Two large, airy bedrooms with views, walk-in closets. Spacious sunroom with stunning views. Sunroom has a closet & can function as a 3rd Bedroom. Bright split bathroom; ensuite with one bedroom. In-unit side-by-side laundry. Huge, light-filled exclusive-use storage space at ground level can serve as an office or studio. Sheltered & serene shared garden. Independent parking. Friendly HOA with low monthly fees. Quiet & private location, only steps from Golden Gate Park. Near Ocean Beach, Presidio, Baker Beach, the DeYoung Museum, SF Botanical Garden, California Academy of Sciences, Rose Garden.  Also close by are numerous playgrounds, shops of Geary & Clement & two SF library branches. Easy access to MUNI, driving routes, bike paths.
